# Deepak Bagada — Portfolio

Deepak Bagada is an AI developer, web developer and SEO/AEO expert from Junagadh, Gujarat, India. He builds websites (Laravel/PHP), AI systems, AI agents and workflow automation, and optimizes everything he builds to rank on Google and in AI answers. He works with clients across India and remotely.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://deepakbagada.in/services/web-development): Website development in Junagadh, Gujarat and India — Laravel, PHP, fast editorial design, built to convert.
- [AI Development](https://deepakbagada.in/services/ai-development): AI development, AI agents, multi-agent systems and automation in Junagadh, Gujarat and India.
- [SEO & AEO](https://deepakbagada.in/services/seo-aeo): SEO and answer engine optimization (AEO) expert in Junagadh, Gujarat — rank on Google and get cited by AI.

## Projects

- [Curro](https://deepakbagada.in/): AI content creation studio — turns rough notes into published posts in the writer's own voice.
- [SaaS Next](https://deepakbagada.in/): Product and marketing website built on Laravel; content engine tripled organic traffic in six months.
- [DailyAIWorld](https://deepakbagada.in/): Daily directory of AI tools and workflows.
